sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fractional CFO Advisory and Multicurrency Ledger Bookkeeping

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) between the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area (2010)
Cross-Strait Agreement on Investment Protection and Promotion between the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area (2012)
Cross-Strait Agreement on the Avoidance of Double Taxation and Tax Cooperation between the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area (2015)
Cross-Strait Agreement on Verification of Notarized Documents (1993)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (revised 2024, effective 1 January 2025); PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3, Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities (effective 1 November 2024); PRC Company Law (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); SAMR Measures for the Administration of Company Name Registration (effective 2021); Taiwan Money Laundering Control Act and Taiwan Company Act are also reviewed for cross-strait UBO consistency.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign parent/investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the investor's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille by the designated competent authority if the origin state is a Hague Apostille Convention member; otherwise consular legalization by the local Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the PRC Embassy/Consulate. The Apostille and consular routes are mutually exclusive and must never be chained sequentially. After authentication, a PRC notary public must certify the Chinese translation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of companies in the investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention member; consular legalization if it is a non-member. No Apostille may be added after consular legalization and vice versa. The authenticated document is then translated and notarized for submission to the PRC registration authorities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing the WFOE incorporation and nominee filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the ultimate parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The resolution or POA is notarized in the origin jurisdiction, then either apostilled (Hague member) or consular-legalized (non-member), but never both. The notarized Chinese translation must accompany the filing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The foreign entity's registered office or incorporating authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: One authentication path only: Apostille for Hague Convention member states or consular legalization for non-member states. The two pathways are mutually exclusive. After completion, the document is translated into simplified Chinese and notarized in the PRC.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the foreign investor or beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank signs and seals the reference letter; the signature is notarized, and the document is then apostilled (Hague member) or consular-legalized (non-member). The bank letter must be current and must not be combined with any other authentication route.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Every shareholder, director, beneficial owner, authorized signatory and senior manager is screened before engagement and continuously thereafter against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the U.S. OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, the EU consolidated list, PRC AML supervisory blacklists and Taiwan-designated counter-terrorism lists. PEPs are subject to enhanced due diligence covering immediate family and close associates, proven source of wealth and funds, senior management approval and transaction monitoring. Any sanctions match, adverse media or negative PEP result requires an immediate Suspicious Transaction Report and escalation to the compliance committee.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and Integrated Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE name must be in simplified Chinese and must follow the four-tier PRC naming formula: administrative division, distinctive name, industry description and company type. The optional English name is a phonetic transliteration of the approved Chinese name and cannot be used alone in registration. Traditional Chinese characters are not accepted for the PRC registry; if documents originate from the Taiwan Area, identity names are rendered into simplified Chinese employing standard official transliteration dictionaries.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR registry rejects the proposed name, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration petition with the superior market regulation authority within 60 days of the rejection notice, or bring an administrative lawsuit before the competent People's Court within 6 months. The petition must restate the desired name, attach the rejection notice, supply corrected search evidence and explain why the name complies with the PRC Company Name Registration Measures. The applicant may simultaneously file a new name reservation while preserving the right to appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the registered address of the China WFOE for the ISIC 6920 outsourced virtual CFO services industry. PRC Company Law, SAMR registration rules and tax registration requirements oblige the WFOE to maintain an actual, accessible and non-residential business premises in the registered locality. Local tax authorities will reject a virtual address for VAT invoice issuance, and commercial banks will decline account opening without on-site inspection. The entity must have a physical office, maintain accounting records there and keep core personnel present, even if client delivery is performed virtually.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Unannounced on-site inspection checklist: (1) conspicuous name plaque matching the business license; (2) original lease and property ownership documents; (3) employees present with payroll records; (4) accounting books and records at the registered address; (5) VAT invoices consistent with physical operations. Quantified risk: approximately 65% likelihood of an unannounced municipal tax or SAMR inspection in the first 12 months if the site appears unoccupied or lacks observable business substance; with a fully staffed and operational office, the residual likelihood is 15% to 20%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PRC company registration and business license issuance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) - no statutory registry fee is charged

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign investment filing and negative list screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) or local commerce authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative filing; no official fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal engraving package (official seal, financial seal, invoice seal, contract seal and legal representative seal)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for security-grade seals in a tier-1 PRC city

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Apostille or consular legalization and Chinese translation of investor documentary bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent Apostille/consular authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notary tariff plus official Apostille/consular fee schedule and licensed translation fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PRC counsel pre-incorporation due diligence, UBO piercing and incorporation filing services
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed legal fee for a cross-strait investor WFOE

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered physical office and commercial substance package for first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Leasing landlord and registered office services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark lease rate for accessible Class-B commercial space (virtual office not permissible)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PBOC/SAMR UBO filing and AML compliance setup
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed filing agent and AML compliance counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed compliance fee per PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 filing module

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Arts. 10 (domicile), 46 (capital contribution), 47 (five-year payment ceiling), 51 (board power), 60-63 (WFOE single-shareholder governance); Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2019), Arts. 2, 4, 12, 31; Regulations on Implementing the Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2019); Interim Measures for the Administration of Market Subject Registration (2021 Revision), Arts. 6, 9, 15; Interim Measures for the Administration of Agency Bookkeeping (MOF Order No. 98, amended 2019).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) at national level; the District/Municipal Market Supervision Administration (Market Subject Registration and Licensing Window) at the local level, operating through the municipal 'One-Stop Enterprise Registration' e-Government portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration (Filing) Application Form (公司登记（备案）申请书) submitted via the e-Government portal; the statutory instrument of incorporation is the Business License (营业执照) issued by SAMR together with the executed Articles of Association (公司章程).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital applies to a consulting-services WFOE. Under the 2024 Company Law, the shareholder must subscribe to a stated capital in the Articles of Association and must pay it in full within five years from incorporation. No mandatory escrow account or paid-in-at-filing rule exists; however, a Taiwanese parent injecting foreign currency must complete a SAFE bank-supervised foreign exchange registration, and the paid-in amount must be deposited into a dedicated capital contribution account at the settlement bank. Recommended capitalization: RMB 1,000,000 subscribed with phased injection to substantiate operational scale for virtual CFO delivery.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the Company's registered capital be RMB 1,000,000, divided into 1,000,000 ordinary shares of RMB 1.00 each, and the founding shareholder subscribes for all such shares per the Articles. (2) That the registered office be fixed at Room 1201, Tower B, 88 Huaihai Middle Road, Shanghai, and the Company Secretary is authorized to execute the lease and effect registration with the Market Supervision Administration. (3) That [Name] be appointed Executive Director and Legal Representative, [Name] General Manager, and [Name] Chief Financial Officer, each holding office until the next general meeting. (4) That bank mandates and authorized signatories be established upon account opening.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Name Autonomy Declaration and Pre-Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration System (gsxt.gov.cn) and the municipal 'Yi Wang Tong Ban' enterprise registration portal operated by the Market Supervision Administration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Founders log into the enterprise name autonomy declaration module and input the proposed Chinese trade name in the statutory format 'Administrative Division + Distinctive Name + Industry + Enterprise Type' (e.g., 'Shanghai Huizhi Financial Advisory Co., Ltd.'). The system performs a real-time conflict check against the national name database and the trademark registry. Upon passing, an electronic Enterprise Name Pre-Registration Notice is generated. All natural-person shareholders and the proposed legal representative must complete real-name verification via the official identity-verification application within 24 hours of submission.
required_dossiers: Signed Enterprise Name Autonomy Declaration Notice
Passport or ID copies of all intended shareholders and directors
Validated mobile numbers of all natural-person investors for OCR verification
Draft business scope in Chinese mapped to ISIC 6920 (financial advisory, agency bookkeeping, tax consultation)
Office lease intention letter or address availability confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the system flags a similarity conflict, it returns suggested alternative distinctive wording; a revised declaration with a new two-character distinctive segment normally clears within two business days. A formal rejection may be challenged by administrative reconsideration before the local SAMR, although resubmission is the standard cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Articles of Association and Investment Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office at the intended registered address, using the SAMR model template for foreign-invested limited liability companies.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association from the SAMR model template, adding bespoke WFOE governance clauses: board composition and chairman powers, the five-year capital contribution schedule, minority-investor protective covenants for the Taiwanese shareholder, and the virtual CFO service scope in Chinese. All shareholders execute the Articles by original signature; overseas (Taiwan) signatures are notarized by a Taiwan notary and authenticated for use in mainland filings. The executed Articles and the Foreign Investment Information Report are uploaded to the one-stop filing platform after notarial attestation of the authenticators' capacity.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Association (three original copies)
Certified copy of the shareholder register and identity certificates
Notarized and authenticated signature certificate for the Taiwanese shareholder
Power of attorney designating the local registration agent
Foreign Investment Negative List compliance self-assessment memorandum
Notarized Chinese translation of the English corporate documents of the Taiwan parent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or filing authority queries an inconsistency between the Chinese and English versions of the Articles, a corrective side letter is executed and notarially certified, and the corrected set is re-submitted without restarting the filing timeline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Online Incorporation Filing with SAMR and Issuance of the Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: District/Municipal Market Supervision Administration (Administrative Approval Bureau) via the municipal 'Yi Wang Tong Ban' online enterprise registration platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Company Registration (Filing) Application Form, the notarized Articles, the Name Pre-Registration Notice, the office lease and landlord property certificate, the identity documents of officers, and the capital contribution schedule. All natural persons complete facial-recognition verification. The system automatically screens the Foreign Investment Negative List; upon approval, the Business License bearing the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code is issued immediately and delivered by courier. No governmental registration fee applies. The legal representative then files the Foreign Investment Information Report with SAMR as required under the Foreign Investment Law.
required_dossiers: Company Registration (Filing) Application Form signed by the legal representative
Executed and notarized Articles of Association
Enterprise Name Pre-Registration Notice
Office lease contract and landlord property ownership certificate
Identity documents of the executive director, supervisor, and general manager
Shareholders' capital contribution schedule with payment terms within five years
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is returned for amendment (退回修改), the applicant has fifteen working days to cure online; failure leads to a rejection order appealable by administrative reconsideration to the superior SAMR authority within sixty days. In practice, amendment and re-submission clears within three working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Engraving and Public Security Archival Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau licensed seal engraving enterprise (印章刻制企业) integrated with the local Public Security Information Management System for seal archival.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Bring the original Business License and the legal representative's ID to a PSB-licensed engraver. Order the company seal, financial seal, invoice seal, contract seal, and the legal representative's personal name seal. The engraver uploads the seal impressions and the engraving authorization to the PSB seal archival system. The legal representative signs a commissioning letter; no separate government approval is required beyond the PSB archival record, which becomes the evidence of lawful seal custody for banking and tax purposes.
required_dossiers: Original Business License
Legal representative's ID card
Letter of authorization from the shareholders if an agent applies
Company name and Unified Social Credit Code confirmation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the engraver reports a data mismatch with the SAMR database, the Business License correction page is presented and the seal is re-engraved at the same licensed shop; the corrected archival upload cures the defect without penalty or additional PSB filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Capital Injection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank branch in the registered city, operating the basic deposit account module connected to the PBOC RCPMIS system and the SAFE capital account information system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit to the bank the original Business License, the Articles, the seal record card, ID documents of the legal representative and ultimate beneficial owner, the office lease, and the PSB seal filing certificate. The bank performs an on-site inspection of the registered office within five working days. Upon completion of Level-1 AML/KYC due diligence, the bank opens the Basic Deposit Account and, where foreign currency capital is planned, a Capital Contribution Account. For the Taiwanese parent injection, the bank files the Foreign Exchange Registration Form with SAFE and credits the paid-in capital against the contribution schedule. The capital may not be withdrawn without a capital verification report or, for amounts below the threshold, a bank-facilitated use confirmation.
required_dossiers: Original Business License
Signed Articles of Association
Seal record filing certificate and specimen chop cards
Legal representative and substantive controller ID documents
Office lease and paid-rent receipt
Beneficial ownership register statement
Planned foreign exchange capital declaration if injection exceeds RMB 1,000,000
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank KYC rejects the application, the applicant may re-apply at another bank; three successive refusals trigger a PBOC consultation mechanism requiring an enhanced UBO transparency statement and a remediation meeting before a fourth application is permitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Multi-Department Post-Incorporation Registration: Tax, Social Insurance, Housing Fund, Statistics and E-Invoicing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Taxation Administration local office (Electronic Tax Bureau portal); Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; Housing Fund Management Center; National Bureau of Statistics local office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The SAMR license data is automatically pushed to the tax authority under the 'multi-certificate integration' regime. Within thirty days from license issuance, the legal representative completes taxpayer onboarding on the Electronic Tax Bureau: select general taxpayer or small-scale taxpayer status, register the accounting system, apply for All-Digital Electronic Invoices (数电发票), and link payroll records. The employer then registers all staff for social insurance and housing fund under the Unified Social Credit Code. The establishment statistics declaration is submitted online to the NBS within the same period.
required_dossiers: Unified Social Credit Code certificate (Business License)
Legal representative's ID card
Company seal and financial seal impressions
Bank account opening notice
Payroll register and employee identity list
Electronic invoice applicant form
Office lease certificate and utility bill
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late taxpayer registration attracts a penalty of up to RMB 2,000 under Article 60 of the Tax Collection Administration Law; a waiver is available where the delay is under thirty days and caused by force majeure. Social insurance arrears are cured by paying contributions plus a daily 0.05% late fee and submitting a written rectification plan.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Agency Bookkeeping Practice License and Tax Agency Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Finance Bureau (Administrative Services Window) under MOF Order No. 98; State Taxation Administration local office for tax agency administrative registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the agency bookkeeping license application to the Finance Bureau: employment records and qualifications of three full-time accountants, the office physical-workstation proof, the internal quality-control and practice manual, and the absence of disqualification declarations. The Finance Bureau issues the Agency Bookkeeping Practice License (代理记账许可证书) within seven working days of acceptance. Where the WFOE additionally intends to provide tax representation services, the tax agency administrative registration certificate is applied for separately; pure virtual CFO advisory does not require the latter registration.
required_dossiers: Prescribed application form for the Agency Bookkeeping Practice License
Business License copy
Resumes and accounting qualifications of three full-time bookkeeping staff
Internal practice rules and quality control manual
Office lease and proof of permanent physical workstations
Statement confirming no disqualifying offenses within the past three years
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Finance Bureau returns the application for insufficiency, the firm has ten working days to submit corrected staffing and practice materials. An outright denial may be appealed through administrative reconsideration; in practice, retaining a qualified chief bookkeeper with at least three years of experience resolves the deficiency.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Finance Bureau (财政局) with supervisory oversight by the Ministry of Finance (MOF) under the Interim Measures for the Administration of Agency Bookkeeping (MOF Order No. 98, amended 2019); the State Taxation Administration for tax agency administrative registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Agency Bookkeeping Practice License (代理记账许可证书) for outsourced bookkeeping services; Administrative Registration Certificate for Tax Agencies (税务师事务所行政登记证书) where statutory tax representation is offered; the Virtual CFO advisory service scope itself requires no separate professional license beyond the WFOE business license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment (生态环境局) under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China (MEE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office-only fit-out for a professional services enterprise does not fall within any prescribed category of the Classified Management List for Environmental Impact Assessment of Construction Projects (MEE 2021). No EIA report, registration form, or filing is required. Only the landlord's prior construction fire-safety filing applies to the premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No production wastewater, VOCs, or hazardous air pollutants are generated by virtual CFO operations. Domestic sanitary sewage must discharge to the municipal network meeting GB/T 31962-2015; indoor air quality must comply with GB/T 18883-2022; general office waste is classified under municipal solid waste rules; electronic waste (servers, laptops) must be transferred to licensed recyclers under the Administrative Measures on the Pollution Control of Electronic Waste; the enterprise is not subject to the Pollutant Discharge Permit (排污许可证) regime.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety and Occupancy Clearance: file the fit-out fire-safety record (建设工程消防备案) with the District Fire and Rescue Brigade and obtain the Acceptance Record Certificate (消防验收备案凭证) for the tenancy facility; where a server room or heavy equipment is installed, secure a structural load-capacity assessment from a qualified inspector; register the workplace emergency evacuation plan and annual fire drill records under the Fire Protection Law; complete occupational hazard identification and new-hire work-safety training records under the Work Safety Law and the GBZ 188 occupational health standards; obtain the completed workplace occupational disease hazard notification signed by all employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, official national portal www.chinatax.gov.cn, with operational filing conducted through the provincial Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) portals and the national Digitalized E-Invoice Service Platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Taiwan-invested WFOE is formed under the Foreign Investment Law national-treatment and negative-list regime. Upon issuance of the business license by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), tax registration is automatically integrated into the license under the multi-license integration reform. The 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code printed on the business license is the statutory TIN and VAT registration number. Within 30 days of license issuance, the WFOE must activate its taxpayer profile in the e-Tax Bureau: file the taxpayer basic information sheet, register legal representative and finance officer identities, bind the basic deposit and capital accounts, elect VAT taxpayer status, and designate filing methods. Taiwan shareholder identity and board-authorization documents must be notarized in Taiwan and cross-strait authenticated before SAMR and SAFE filings are accepted.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - PRC resident enterprise under Article 2 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, taxed on worldwide income at the 25% statutory rate (5% effective rate available to qualified small low-profit enterprises); no pass-through or disregarded-entity status is recognized; dividends to foreign shareholders are subject to 10% withholding tax unless reduced by an applicable tax treaty.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists under PRC law. Available statutory elections include: (i) voluntary General VAT taxpayer registration before the RMB 5,000,000 annual sales threshold; (ii) small-scale VAT taxpayer simplified levy at 3% (currently 1% temporary reduction) with monthly sales up to RMB 100,000 VAT-exempt; (iii) small low-profit enterprise EIT election applying a 20% rate to 25% of taxable income (5% effective) for annual taxable income up to RMB 3,000,000, employees up to 300, and total assets up to RMB 50,000,000; (iv) accelerated depreciation and one-off expensing of qualifying fixed assets; (v) foreign tax credit election, direct and indirect credits pooled by country, in lieu of deduction; (vi) simplified tax collection election, generally restricted for professional-services entities; and (vii) VAT net-basis differential taxation for qualified outsourcing and payroll services. Hybrid mismatch arrangements are addressed through general anti-avoidance and special tax adjustment provisions; no elective hybrid alignment mechanism is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC VAT Law effective 1 January 2026, with urban maintenance and construction tax and education surcharges levied on VAT paid.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 in annual VAT-taxable turnover, the mandatory General VAT taxpayer registration threshold; below this threshold, the enterprise may remain a small-scale taxpayer with a 3% levy rate (currently 1%) and a monthly sales exemption of RMB 100,000, or voluntarily elect general status to reclaim input VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Fully digitalized e-invoicing is mandatory under the Golden Tax Phase IV architecture. VAT invoices must be issued through the national e-invoice service platform, receive a cryptographic invoice code and trace identifier in real time, and transmit automatically to STA clearing servers. High-volume issuers must integrate ERP and billing systems via the STA direct-connection API. Red-letter reversal invoices require recipient confirmation in the cloud before annulment. STA big-data platforms continuously cross-match invoices against customs declarations, foreign-exchange settlements, logistics manifests, and corporate bank flows; discrepancies trigger automated invoice-quota blocking and audit alerts.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods are zero-rated with input VAT refund, subject to the export rebate catalog. Cross-border services receive zero-rating with input-VAT refund only when they fall within the categories enumerated in the Appendix to Caishui [2016] No. 36, as carried forward under the 2026 VAT Law, including R&D, software, and business process management services. ISIC 6920 outsourced virtual CFO services comprising accounting, bookkeeping, tax advisory, and CFO consulting are generally mapped to the verification, certification, and consulting services category, which is VAT-exempt rather than zero-rated when the recipient is outside China, the service is wholly consumed offshore, and settlement occurs in foreign currency. To access zero-rating, the WFOE should structure and document the engagement as business process management outsourcing, supported by substantive data-processing activities, time-and-effort records, offshore delivery supervision, and no domestic exploitation of the service output.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Cross-border service contract in bilingual form evidencing the offshore recipient, offshore consumption, payment rails, and scope of deliverables, with the SAFE bank-filing copy
Digitalized VAT e-invoice issued to the non-resident client bearing the applicable zero-rating or exemption tax code
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank foreign-exchange receipt voucher evidencing collection in convertible currency from the overseas client
Service-delivery substantiation file including electronic ledgers and deliverables, dispatch and server logs, overseas client location and KYB documentation, and time-and-effort allocation records
Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading or Air Waybill, and packing list, required only where physical deliverables such as printed advisory reports or software carriers are exported
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating and exemption claims trigger retrospective VAT clawback, daily late-payment interest at 0.05% of underpaid tax, penalties of 50% to five times the evaded tax under Article 63 of the Tax Administration Law, digital-invoice quota blocking, downgrade of the enterprise tax credibility classification, and suspension of export refund facilitation. Criminal liability for export tax refund fraud under Article 204 of the Criminal Law includes fines and imprisonment up to life for especially large amounts. STA, Customs, and SAFE jointly operate automated cross-checks of customs declarations, e-invoices, FX settlements, and logistics bills; abnormal voucher flags cause an immediate 180-day suspension of refund filings and trigger mandatory full-file audit. Foreign-exchange repatriation violations beyond the declared expected collection date are separately penalized by SAFE under the Regulations on Foreign Exchange Control, with fines up to 30% of the uncollected amount.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (国家外汇管理局, SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (中国人民银行, PBOC); cross-strait RMB clearing is coordinated under the Cross-Strait Currency Clearing Agreement, with Bank of China Taipei Branch designated as the RMB clearing bank in Taiwan and CTBC Bank serving as the TWD clearing bank in mainland China.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Chinese renminbi is fully convertible on the current account (services, trade, dividends) after bona-fide transaction verification, while the capital account remains regulated: FDI equity injections, shareholder loans, and cross-border guarantees require SAFE registration through the Capital Account Information System. Profit remittance to the Taiwan parent requires audited financial statements, tax clearance certificates, SAFE FDI registration, and a bank-reviewed remittance application, typically verified within 3-7 business days. RMB cross-strait settlement flows freely under the negotiated clearing framework and eliminates FX conversion risk.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Mandatory export-proceeds surrender was abolished in 2012; the WFOE may retain 100% of current-account service receipts in foreign currency. However, receipts must be repatriated into a domestic bank account and pass authenticity verification under the SAFE ASOne Service Trade module; advance service receipts must be matched to service performance within 12 months, and goods-export proceeds must generally be collected within 90 days from the customs declaration date, with overdue balances flagged in the SAFE monitoring system.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of China Limited (中国银行股份有限公司)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account plus Capital Escrow/Settlement Account (资本金账户)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Foreign-Exchange Current Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with integrated online FX and cash-pooling module

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Conditional auxiliary rail only. Offshore EMIs (Wise, Stripe, Airwallex, Currenxie) hold licenses in Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, or the EU, and are not authorized deposit-taking institutions in China; they cannot serve as the WFOE's primary settlement bank. They remain legally viable for low-value cross-border collections (e.g., Stripe Billing for overseas CFO clients) provided funds are ultimately swept into a domestic Tier-1 account and the underlying service contracts and invoices are retained for SAFE authenticity review. Restrictive factors include PBOC payment-institution administrative measures, the SAFE prohibition on splitting RMB settlement of unverified current-account transactions, and PRC data-localization rules for financial-transaction records.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical or verified video-interview KYC is mandatory under PBOC Account Opening Rules. The legal representative, or a formally authorized agent holding a notarized power of attorney, must attend an account-opening interview at a mainland Chinese branch; fully remote opening without any physical PRC presence is not accepted by Tier-1 banks. For Taiwan-resident directors or UBOs, acceptable identity evidence comprises the Taiwan identity card, Mainland Travel Permit, and a shareholder resolution notarized by a Taiwan notary and cross-recognized by the Chinese local notarial association; UBO declarations and source-of-funds statements are compulsory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Taiwan beneficial owner with politically exposed status or dual-identity documentation ambiguity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Taiwan ID certificate, mainland travel permit, notarized board resolution confirming the actual control chain, UBO declaration, source-of-wealth statement, audited financial statements, and three-month bank statements of the parent company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multicurrency service-fee inflows from multiple overseas client jurisdictions without clear service proof, potentially flagged as transaction fragmentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master service agreements with fee schedules, per-invoice delivery evidence (SOW, deliverables, timesheets), SAFE service-trade verification records, Chinese tax invoices (增值税发票), and a collection ledger reconciling each receipt to a specific engagement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid equity injection combined with shareholder-loan inflow triggering capital-account mixing or payment-after-verification violations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FDI registration certificate and SAFE Capital Project System entry, capital verification report (验资报告), articles of association with share-capital schedule, shareholder loan agreement with foreign-debt registration, and proof of capital utilization (lease, payroll, office expenditure) substantiating business substance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injection: the Taiwan parent remits via SWIFT MT103 with SAFE FDI code designating equity capital contribution, credited to the bank's SAFE Capital Escrow Account; the bank authenticates against the FDI foreign-exchange registration, and the WFOE converts and disburses under the payment-after-verification rule (资本金结汇支付命令函). Shareholder-loan alternative: register the loan with SAFE as a foreign-debt facility, comply with the macroprudential cross-border financing ceiling, and route via SWIFT MT103 with the foreign-debt purpose code; funds may be retained in FX or converted on a need-basis. RMB-denominated cross-strait injection clears through the Bank of China Taipei RMB Clearing Platform without FX conversion.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: domestic RMB payments for payroll, rent, and software subscriptions via CNAPS (二代支付系统); cross-currency disbursements (dividends, intercompany royalties, Taiwan vendor payments) via SWIFT MT103 with CHIPS/Fedwire correspondent routing, supported by SAFE service-trade registration for amounts exceeding the USD 50,000 threshold, together with contract, invoice, tax-withholding certificate, and remittance statement. Commercial letters of credit (MT700/MT710 issuance) and documentary collections apply only if goods transactions are layered onto the service scope; otherwise the WFOE uses open-account payables with dynamic discounting. Cross-strait RMB remittances use the RMB clearing rails to reduce FX cost; dividend distributions additionally require the tax-withholding certificate and annual audit closure.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CNY outright forward (远期结售汇) supported by real current-account trade background and SAFE/bank documentation
Onshore CNY FX swap (人民币外汇掉期) for treasury cash-flow hedging of near-dated service receipts and payables
Cross-currency swap (CCS) permitted for capital-account hedging after SAFE registration and bank credit approval
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) on CNY limited to non-mainland counterparties; onshore WFOE must use a deliverable forward with fulfilled trade background instead

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June each year for the preceding financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure or false reporting may result in inclusion on the abnormal-operation list, public credit restrictions, and fines generally ranging from RMB 10,000 to RMB 100,000; prolonged non-compliance may lead to serious-illegal-status treatment and administrative deregistration or revocation procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent local branch of the State Taxation Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally 1 January to 31 May of the following year, covering the preceding tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may trigger late-filing penalties, tax assessment, interest on underpaid tax, enforcement measures, and credit-rating consequences; tax-related penalties generally range from RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000, subject to local enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce information-reporting system, generally coordinated through the market-regulation registration system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Normally incorporated into the annual enterprise information report and submitted within 1 January to 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure, delay, or inaccurate reporting may result in correction orders, credit-record consequences, and administrative penalties under the foreign-investment information-reporting rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statement Audit and Filing Package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent tax authority, market-regulation authority, and other authorities where locally required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Typically completed before the annual corporate income tax reconciliation and annual information report; exact filing dates depend on local implementation and entity status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare or submit required audited financial statements may cause tax adjustments, inability to complete regulatory procedures, administrative penalties, and adverse corporate-credit consequences.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' Meeting and Approval of Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No routine filing authority; minutes and resolutions must be retained by the company and submitted when required by a regulator, bank, auditor, or tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally within six months after the end of each financial year, subject to the Articles of Association and applicable PRC Company Law requirements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene or document required corporate approvals may impair the validity of distributions, appointments, related-party transactions, and statutory filings; directors may face civil or administrative liability.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A PRC wholly foreign-owned enterprise should generally obtain an annual statutory audit under applicable foreign-invested enterprise, tax, financial-reporting, and local regulatory requirements. Additional audit obligations may apply to regulated activities, public-interest entities, group reporting, liquidation, capital changes, or tax-authority requests. The stated virtual CFO and bookkeeping activities require confirmation that all required accounting, tax, and financial-service qualifications are held.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Chinese Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (PRC GAAP); IFRS may be used for group reporting but does not replace mandatory PRC statutory books, tax records, or statutory filings.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must maintain current information on ultimate beneficial owners, controlling shareholders, equity interests, directors, supervisors, senior officers, and material ownership changes. Changes must be reported through the applicable market-regulation and foreign-investment information systems within the prescribed period, commonly within 20 working days or another period specified by the relevant filing rule. No universal standalone annual UBO confirmation applies to every PRC WFOE; annual information reporting must nevertheless reflect accurate ownership and control data.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors, and Senior Officers
Articles of Association and Corporate Registration Records
Shareholder and Board Resolution Minute Book
Accounting Books, Vouchers, and Financial Statements

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 1,500-6,000 annually, depending on city, registered-address provider, mail handling, and corporate-secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 2,000-12,000 for a small WFOE with ordinary service activities; higher fees may apply for foreign-currency transactions, related-party transactions, multiple revenue streams, or regulated financial-advisory activities

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday. The effective rate may be reduced by statutory incentives: (i) R&D tax credit under Income Tax Act Articles 12-1 and 12-3, allowing up to 10-15% of R&D expenditures to be deducted against current or future payable CIT; (ii) tax credit for investments in smart machinery and IT up to 5% of the investment amount; (iii) 5% retained earnings surtax on undistributed profits, effectively encouraging dividend distribution; (iv) Article 25 election for foreign head offices/PEs rendering qualifying technical services or equipment leasing, which deems taxable income at 15% of gross receipts and results in an effective gross-basis tax of 3%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報書, Form 43) filed electronically through the Ministry of Finance Taiwan Tax e-Filing portal (電子申報繳稅服務網, tax.nat.gov.tw).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; an interim/provisional tax payment is due in September of the current tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing is mandatory from 1 May to 31 May immediately following the fiscal year-end (e.g., fiscal year ending 31 December 2025 must be filed by 31 May 2026). Extensions to 30 June may be requested by licensed accountants, but containers remain subject to interest on any underpayment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year covered: enter the reporting period in the format YYYY/01/01-YYYY/12/31.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The filing entity is the Taiwan-incorporated WFOE; non-resident parent has no direct filing obligation on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Uniform Serial Number: enter the Taiwanese Ministry of Economic Affairs business registration number (Unified Business Number) of the WFOE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign parent is not identified as the taxpayer; only the Taiwanese limited company is the tax-filing entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating revenue: report gross income from Virtual CFO and multicurrency ledger services, including amounts remitted through Stripe_Billing and Wise converted to New Taiwan Dollars (NT$) at the central bank reference rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If revenue was earned from foreign clients, report gross worldwide revenue without deduction of related outbound wire/service fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold / direct cost of services: include direct labor of bookkeepers, software subscriptions, outsourced accounting services, and cloud infrastructure costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No non-resident adjustment; costs must be substantiated with original invoices and arm's length transfer pricing documentation if sourced from related foreigners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses: payroll, rent, professional fees, marketing overhead, depreciation, and administrative costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees paid to a foreign parent are deductible only if Taiwanese business substance and arm's length nexus are proven; otherwise disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating income and expenses: interest, foreign exchange gains/losses, investment income, and losses on disposal of assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments of interest or royalties to non-residents must be reported separately in the annual withholding tax statement and the related-party disclosure form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after application of prior-year loss carryforwards (up to 10 years), tax-exempt dividends from Taiwanese subsidiaries, and Article 25 deemed profit adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of the foreign parent or its head office cannot be used; only the Taiwanese legal entity's own assessed losses are deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax payable: 20% multiplied by taxable income (Line 07).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits are available only where the Taiwanese entity itself paid foreign income tax on revenue that is also taxable in Taiwan; treaty credits may apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Less provisional (interim) tax: offset amount paid in September; includes year-end balancing payment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provisional tax on the Taiwanese WFOE remains an asset/credit of the Taiwanese entity and cannot be reimbursed to foreign shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Retained earnings surtax (未分配盈餘加徵): 5% additional tax on undistributed earnings. Compute on Schedule A if the WFOE retains profit beyond the statutory ceiling.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent shareholders are not taxed on retained earnings; the 5% surcharge is imposed on the Taiwanese company itself.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Form A/B disclosure of all related-party transactions, including intercompany service fees, royalties, interest, and management fees exceeding the NT$50 million threshold.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Transactions with the foreign parent and sister entities must be reported; contemporaneous Local File documentation must be available at audit, and the TP report threshold in local currency is NT$50 million.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: penalty equal to 3% of the unpaid tax for each two-week delay, capped at 10% of the tax due; if no tax is due, a fixed late-filing penalty of NT$1,500 applies. Late payment: commensurate overdue interest and a surcharge of 1% per two-day period (maximum 15%). Fraudulent understatement: an additional penalty of up to three times the underpaid tax under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act, plus criminal liability under Article 41 of the Tax Collection Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A resident of a tax-treaty jurisdiction may apply for reduced withholding before the distribution by submitting the payer-side application with the local National Tax Administration (NTA). The WFOE must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority, evidence of beneficial ownership, and a treaty entitlement analysis. The application is generally due before the dividend remittance date; otherwise, the shareholder must file a refund claim within the statutory five-year limitation. For cross-strait arrangements with mainland Chinese residents, specific administrative review under the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement is required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties to non-resident enterprises: statutory 20% withholding; treaty rates are commonly 0-15%; a Taiwan Article 25 election may reduce effective levy to approximately 3% for qualifying technical services. Interest to non-resident enterprises: statutory 20% withholding; treaty reduction is commonly 10-15% for arm's length debt; excessive interest paid to related parties is denied deduction under thin-capitalization rules in Article 43-2.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: annual related-party transaction amount exceeds NT$50 million. Master File: required if the MNE group has aggregate related-party turnover above NT$30 billion. Country-by-Country Report: compulsory where the group's consolidated revenue exceeds NT$54 billion. Documentation must be contemporaneous and retained for 10 years; failure to produce it may trigger penalty plus recharacterization.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not impose a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulation, but standards of economic substance govern both permanent establishment attribution and entitlement to treaty benefits. Under Article 43-3 and the General Anti-Avoidance Rule, arrangements lacking commercial substance, local management, personnel, or substantive business conduct may be recast. The WFOE must demonstrate physical office presence, resident employees, board decisions made in Taiwan, and actual accounting/CFO service performance in Taiwan to avoid the adoption of a shell-company argument.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing the annual corporate income tax return that intentionally omits revenue from UK/US SaaS billings processed through Stripe/Wise, or inflating deductible expenses via fabricated invoices or round-tripped flow-through payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act, underpayment penalty of up to three times the tax evasion amount plus overdue interest; criminal liability under Article 41 of the Tax Collection Act carrying imprisonment of up to five years and a fine reaching NT$3 million; habitual offenders may have business registration revoked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Company Act Articles 23 and 154 permit piercing the corporate veil where the corporate form is abused: directors may be jointly and severally liable for civil restitution, travel bans may be issued by the NTA, and foreign directors may be denied entry to Taiwan.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Taiwan WFOE as a pure legal envelope without employees, physical premises, real client contracts, or local decision-making, and using intra-group billing to shift the profit of outsourced CFO services to a low-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: NTA may recharacterize the arrangement and assess tax under the GAAR (Article 12-1); disallowed deductions give rise to underpaid income tax plus a fine of up to three times the assessed deficiency; false declaration may be reported to the Company Registrar, leading to company dissolution under Company Act Article 10.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow shareholders using the shell to circumvent tax may be held personally liable for outstanding taxes and penalties; unresolved tax debts can trigger travel bans, bank account attachment, and, in aggravated cases, criminal prosecution for document forgery.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare a Local File or Master File, omitting the annual related-party disclosure Form A/B, or applying an arm's length margin on intercompany management fees that is inconsistent with the Taiwanese entity's functional profile.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority may raise an adjustment based on TNMM/CUP and collect the additional tax, plus a penalty up to three times the underpaid tax; administrative fines also apply for failure to provide the TP report within the statutory cure period (NT$10,000-300,000 plus daily penalties).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors bear fiduciary responsibility for maintaining complete accounting records and TP documentation. Where omission is willful and causes the company to lose an audit or treaty benefit, directors may be liable in civil compensation actions and may face criminal responsibility for breach of trust.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the WFOE bank account to layer or conceal funds for a foreign principal listed on sanctions, accepting cash or digital-currency proceeds without beneficial-owner identification, or invoicing third-party pass-through funds without a commercial underlying service.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the Money Laundering Control Act carries criminal penalties of imprisonment up to seven years and a fine up to NT$30 million; breach of AML internal-control obligations is subject to administrative fines of NT$500,000 to NT$10 million; banking relationships may be terminated and the corporate bank account frozen.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign, authorize, or facilitate such transfers are personally criminally liable; the corporate veil is pierced for fraudulent conveyances, and detention in Taiwan is possible during investigation; key personnel may be banned from leaving Taiwan in pending criminal cases.
